verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented only as a terminal TUI, headless CLI, and ACP agent. There is no first-party desktop app and no visual diff-review feature in the evidence. The TUI dashboard gives an overview of sessions, and worktrees isolate parallel agents, but neither is a desktop app with side-by-side sessions. The only desktop GUI mentioned is a community Tauri fork with unknown features, so it is not the product itself.
